title: Smart Queue & Feedback Management System MVP (Frontend)

requirements.summary: User queue flow: select a service, join/leave queue, and view live-refreshed queue status (position + status) with manual refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a clear flow to select a service and join its queue.
After joining, the UI displays the user’s current position and status state.
The UI provides a cancel/leave action and updates state after completion.
Queue status view refreshes via polling (React Query) at a reasonable interval (e.g., every 5–10 seconds) and supports manual refresh.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell with primary navigation between Queue, Feedback, and Admin areas; integrate authentication gating per the selected authorization component (require login before showing application data). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add an AuthGate that uses Internet Identity state to require login before rendering queue data; show a clear English prompt to log in. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a Login/Logout button that uses the authorization component’s recommended Internet Identity flow and clears React Query cache on logout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a first-login profile setup dialog (collect name) using getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile to avoid showing principal IDs; ensure no modal flash per guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a React Query hook to fetch and cache listServices for service selection; ensure queries are enabled only when the backend actor is available.

Create React Query hooks for joinQueue, leaveQueue, and queue status retrieval; include polling (e.g., 7s) and a manual refresh function; derive user position + status by combining queue snapshot with current identity principal.

Build the user Queue UI: service selector, join button, live status card (position + status), manual refresh control, and leave/cancel action; show English errors from backend traps in a user-friendly way; use shadcn-ui components by composition only (do not edit immutable ui paths). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure actor-dependent queries used by queue UI behave correctly across login/logout (including cache invalidation) and provide a stable actor reference for React Query hooks.

requirements.summary: User feedback flow: select a service, submit rating + optional comment, and show confirmation after success with clear error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Feedback form includes a rating control and a comment field (comment optional).
Submission errors are shown in English with actionable guidance.
On success, the form resets and shows a confirmation message in English.

file_operations.description: Create React Query mutation hook for submitFeedback and query hook for listServices (reuse services hook) to support selecting a service and submitting feedback; handle and normalize errors into clear English messages.

Build feedback UI with service selector, rating control, optional comment field, submit button, success confirmation/receipt state, and error display; use shadcn-ui components by composition only (do not edit immutable ui paths). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire FeedbackPage into the app’s primary navigation and ensure it is protected by the AuthGate (login required before showing application data). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Admin/staff area: manage queue (view entries, serve next, no-show/cancel, clear) and review feedback per service with authorization-aware UI behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin view shows a service selector and a queue list (ordered) with each entry’s state.
Admin actions (advance, no-show/cancel, clear) trigger backend updates and the UI reflects changes.
Admin view includes a feedback list per service (rating, comment, timestamp).
If the user is not authorized as admin, admin actions are disabled or the admin view is hidden with a clear English message.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for admin capabilities: isCallerAdmin, getQueueSnapshot (polling), serveNext, markNoShow, leave/cancel (as no-show/cancel action), and getServiceFeedback; include cache invalidation so lists refresh after mutations.

Build Admin UI: service selector, ordered queue list with entry state, action buttons (serve next, mark no-show/cancel per entry, clear queue), and feedback list (rating/comment/timestamp); hide or disable admin actions when not authorized and show a clear English message; use shadcn-ui components by composition only (do not edit immutable ui paths). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a reusable AccessDeniedScreen for unauthorized admin access with clear English messaging and a path back to user areas. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire AdminPage into the app navigation and gate it behind an admin check (isCallerAdmin); show AccessDeniedScreen or disable admin controls for non-admin users. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive visual theme across the frontend (non-blue/purple primary), with consistent layout and component styling across Queue, Feedback, and Admin areas.
acceptanceCriteria: The app uses a consistent palette (primary/secondary/background/text) and typographic scale across pages.
Primary brand color is not blue or purple.
Layout is consistent (header/nav, content widths, card styles) across Queue, Feedback, and Admin areas.

file_operations.description: Define global theme styles (typography scale, spacing rhythm, and a warm neutral palette with teal/orange accents) ensuring the primary brand color is not blue or purple; integrate with Tailwind/shadcn-ui theming via CSS variables where applicable. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a shared layout (header with logo + nav, consistent content width, consistent card/section spacing) used by Queue, Feedback, and Admin pages; compose shadcn-ui components without editing immutable ui paths. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Adopt AppLayout for all areas and ensure consistent header/nav and page structure across Queue, Feedback, and Admin. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required generated static images under frontend/public/assets/generated and render logo in header, hero on home screen, and empty-state illustration in relevant UI states.
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
At least the logo is used in the app header and the hero illustration is used on the landing/home screen.
Images are loaded as static assets (no backend image serving).

file_operations.description: Add the required generated logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-logo.dim_256x256.png.
Add the required generated hero illustration asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-hero.dim_1200x600.png.
Add the required generated empty-state illustration asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-empty-state.dim_512x512.png.

Render the static logo in the app header using frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-logo.dim_256x256.png; ensure it appears consistently across Queue, Feedback, and Admin areas. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a landing/home hero section that renders frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-hero.dim_1200x600.png and brief English guidance for using the app; keep it within existing app shell (do not introduce additional top-level routes beyond what App.tsx provides). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the empty-state illustration frontend/public/assets/generated/sqfm-empty-state.dim_512x512.png in the 'No active queue' UI state with clear English text and a call-to-action to join a service queue. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire HomeHero into the initial view/landing area within the main app shell so the hero illustration is visible on the landing/home screen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
